requested_outcome: Create a permanent Last Minute Vacation page, visually aligned with the holiday detail family but with a distinct non-holiday identity, and route the homepage last-minute all-results link to it.
natural_destination: VII homepage last-minute slider and the new public /last-minute page
authorization_boundary: Implementation and local verification are authorized. Production publication requires a separate explicit instruction.

lesson_bundle.reason: The short request implies a complete user journey from the homepage slider to a useful permanent destination.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify the link, page meaning, live results and next action as one journey.

lesson_bundle.reason: A shared homepage and results component is changing and regressions have recurred in this family.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Retest the existing date tabs, holiday page family, failure state, mobile and desktop before release.

lesson_bundle.reason: The page uses responsive live-result rails and must survive viewport transitions.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Test mobile, desktop, resize, reload and horizontal overflow.

lesson_bundle.reason: The new public mobile destination needs visible rendered evidence, not DOM-only checks.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Capture and inspect the mobile and desktop page at the natural destination.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The homepage link still opens a generic dated search instead of a permanent page.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Change only the last-minute all-results target and verify the rendered anchor.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Clicking the last-minute all-results link opens /last-minute and reload preserves that route.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The page looks like a renamed Hanukkah page and uses holiday language or symbols.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use dedicated spontaneous-travel imagery and copy with no holiday terminology.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Hero, metadata, content and image are about near-term spontaneous travel and contain no holiday-specific copy.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The page is decorative but does not show verified last-minute availability and prices.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Reuse the verified home-deals data path, locked to the tomorrow period.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The page loads the tomorrow API, renders real cards when available and retains loading, empty and retry states.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The shared deal slider or holiday pages regress.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Make the fixed-period behavior opt-in and test existing near and holiday modes unchanged.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Homepage near-date tabs and a holiday detail page still render and interact.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The page is cramped or overflows on mobile.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Reuse the approved holiday layout rhythm and test live breakpoint transitions.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: At 390px and desktop the hero, cards and actions are visible without horizontal document overflow.

affected_family: holiday deal pages sharing the deal card family
metadata, breadcrumbs, structured FAQ and canonical URL

sources.label: Approved holiday detail layout and live availability journey

midpoint_gate.trigger: The new route renders with the fixed tomorrow period and the homepage link points to it.
checks: The page has the requested title and non-holiday hero.
The page requests only the last-minute period.

attack_questions: Can the link fall back to generic search after hydration?
Can admin default-period settings change this page away from last minute?
Does an API error leave a dead or blank page?
Does resizing leave a locked or overflowing rail?
Did the opt-in change alter existing homepage or holiday behavior?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Rendered browser evidence for the homepage click and the /last-minute page on desktop and mobile.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Build, targeted tests, existing homepage tab checks and representative holiday-page regression.

effectiveness.baseline: The last-minute all-results link currently opens a dated generic search and no permanent /last-minute editorial page exists.
effectiveness.target: One direct homepage-to-page journey with zero missing-route, wrong-period or responsive regressions.
